components.supportScope: Physical support derives only from owned lower-jamb UV domain and its affine mapping. Upper curved-arch/no-material columns and subpixel margins use explicit virtual extension from the nearest physical baseline; not claimed physical pixels. Alpha128 locates measured edge only, native rendering alpha unchanged.
